blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense and migrant workers officials on Saturday warned Filipinos against deceptive job offers that could land them in war zones amid allegations that Filipino workers were being trained for military service in Russia. Department of National Defense (DND) spokesperson Assistant Secretary Arsenio Andolong said the defense department was in consultations with the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and other government agencies over the matter. “We strongly urge our fellow Filipinos, both at home and abroad, to exercise extreme vigilance against predatory recruitment syndicates that may put their lives and safety at risk,” Andolong said in a statement.
